title: Taking the temperature on climate change and on just transition policies
discussion_signal: The discussion says climate concern is broad but support for policy depends on effectiveness, economic security, transparent compensation, and fair distribution of transition burdens, especially for financially vulnerable households and workers in high-emission sectors.
linked_research_question: How do perceived effectiveness, economic security, and fairness shape public support for climate and just-transition policy?
limits: The post summarizes public-opinion research without exposing the full comparative dataset
Attitudes do not prove policy behaviour or implementation outcomes
The discussion is an interpretation of OECD evidence and may simplify subgroup differences
